name: Black Land Rover Discovery Sport SUV Jeep 12v Electric Ride On Car
description: Licensed Matt Black Land Rover Discovery Sport SUV Jeep 12v kids ride on car is fully loaded with MP4 video player, leather seat, rubber EVA tyres, working lights and parental remote control. The design and build of this ride on car is absolutely stunning and very close to the real thing! It has functionalities such as horn, car sounds, etc. The ride on car has 12V rechargeable battery , twin motors, with a full functional remote control for parents who's kids cannot reach the accelerator pedal or cannot control the car, so the car be controlled by the parent remotely and the child rides in the car. If necessary the parent can override the child's driving using the remote control. Comes complete with the battery charger and all necessary accessories. Please note that some self assembly is required. Features: Official Licensed Land Rover Ride on MP4 Video Player Leather Seat Rubber EVA Tyres Drives forwards, backwards, left, right 2.4G Parental full function Remote Control Doors Opening Working lights Light up dashboard with voltage display Engine and horn sounds Rechargeable 12V battery and charger Speed: 3-5Km/Hr 2 x 30W Motor Max. Load 40Kg Suitable for age 2-5 Assembled Dimensions: 130cm x 69cm x 56cm What's included? 1 x SUV Jeep ride on car 1 x Remote Control 1 x UK Charger for the car battery 1 x 12V Rechargeable battery for car 1 x User Manual We also stock Land Rover Discovery Sport SUV Jeep in Pink. There are many car colour choices for adults, but often white or blue are most commonly chosen. Bright red or yellow are choices for people who want to stand out, but are also the vehicles that most commonly get pulled over by the police. When searching for the best gift for your child, you may not wish to buy them a bland black or white vehicle, but you want to go beyond red. Orange is perhaps one of the most popular colour choices for kids, as they have no hangups about it—it stands out, it’s easily seen on the road, and it looks good. The 12v Land Rover Discovery Sport electric SUV Jeep ride on car just happens to come in an orange colour option. This vehicle is also sold in pink, white, and red colour options. Parents may prefer a nice bright colour as when they’re playing with their kids outside, drivers of real vehicles will see that black Discovery Sport 12v SUV Jeep ride on vehicle much more clearly than a grey one. This means that your kid stays safe on the road. Your child will also appreciate that while their vehicle may look like yours, theirs will be in a bright and unique colour that really stands out. Kids are often attracted to visuals, rather than appreciating how a product really works. They’ll soon learn about mechanics and electronics as they get older though. But a youngster can appreciate the shape, size, and colour of an object. They’ll be excited to get behind the wheel of the Black Land Rover Discovery Sport 12v electric SUV Jeep ride on car to give it a try. Besides the orange body of the car, it has dark grey windshields, and distinctive Sport Coupe and Land Rover logos. The bumper is colour coded, with the traditional black tires colour. Inside the vehicle, the seat is black, with a black steering wheel and console. The front lights are lit by LEDs and are quite bright. While you don’t want your kid on the road playing after dark by themselves, this provides a bit of extra comfort in knowing that the toy car is visible to oncoming vehicles. The Black Land Rover Discovery Sport 12v SUV Jeep ride on can also be driven forwards and backwards through two different gears. It can also move left and right, to cover all the usual movements of a real vehicle. The doors also open and close, though there is only room for one child. The dashboard on the vehicle actually lights up, and there is a voltage display that tells you how much power is left in the vehicle. You may not buy yourself an orange car for the road, but think how much your child will love the Black Discovery Sport 12v electric SUV Jeep ride on car! Buy one now and see how excited they are to try it out when you have it fully assembled out of the box.
